The chart's underlying data points appear to have been invented by the app's marketing team.
The survey behind the chart only included users from a single region of the country overall.
The claim relies on a product designer's personal opinion instead of any actual measured data.
explanation: Misleading Statistics / Truncated Axis: starting the axis at 1% visually balloons the bars, and framing the change as "62% more likely" (a relative percentage) hides that the real-world shift is only about 1.3 percentage points of all users, a small absolute change dressed up to look huge.
